items.title: Pay outstanding debt-collection balance
items.quote: Zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens am Mittwoch, 02.12.2026 auf unser Treuhandkonto.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date for payment: Wednesday, 02.12.2026. This is a private claim (collection agency acting for the internet provider), so the deadline is taken as written; no statutory delivery-fiction or period counting applies since a fixed date is given. 02.12.2026 is indeed a Wednesday and a regular working day in NW, so no weekend/holiday adjustment is needed.

warnings: This is a private debt-collection demand (Inkassoschreiben), not an official authority decision; there is no legal-remedy instruction (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) and no court can be addressed directly — if the underlying claim is disputed, raise it in writing with the creditor/collection agency and check the original invoices before paying.

The letter mentions a 'Mahnung' sent on 12.10.2026 for August/September 2026 charges; verify with the original provider (Beispielnetz Kabel GmbH) that these invoices were actually received and unpaid before transferring money, since fake or inflated collection letters are a known scam pattern.

The letter offers to dispute the claim ('Wenn Sie die Forderung bestreiten...') but gives no deadline for doing so; if disputing, do it promptly and in writing, ideally before the 02.12.2026 payment date, to avoid further collection steps.
